description: Race or ethnicity classification field stored as string. Contains 30 records with no missing values and 6 distinct observed values representing three semantic categories (Chinese, Malay, Indian). Casing inconsistencies detected: Malay appears as 'Malay', 'MALAY', and 'malay'; Indian appears as 'Indian' and 'indian'; Chinese appears consistently as 'Chinese'.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Standardise deterministic case-only deviations using Title Case: 'MALAY' → 'Malay', 'malay' → 'Malay', 'indian' → 'Indian'.
